title: The second look overrules the fast check
about: A claim the fast check contradicts goes to the Investigator after one uncorrected turn. When the Investigator finds the claim was right, Egg Head says nothing.

lines.speaker: Sam
lines.text: The orders DB is fine, CPU is normal.
lines.why: the fast check says orders-db is degraded

lines.speaker: Jordan
lines.text: Then it's probably the new connection pool code.

lines.speaker: Priya
lines.text: Okay, so let's focus on the API then.
lines.why: the agent found the claim was right: stay quiet, even in a long gap
